description: Building a stronger helmet that 100% blocks UV rays from hitting an astronaut's face .
summary:
Designing a safer, innovative, and more cost-effective space helmet that 100% blocks ultraviolet (UV) solar radiation from reaching the face.
The Solid-Shell Spacesuit helmet replaces traditional fragile glass visors with a fully enclosed, robust shell made from ballistic felt and advanced composite materials. Instead of direct viewing, it utilizes an external array of high-resolution optical cameras connected to internal micro-OLED VR displays. This design completely eliminates physical and radiation vulnerabilities, providing superior bullet-proof protection, cosmic ray shielding, and an augmented reality (AR) visual interface for astronauts.
